decisions.reason: The spring-controlled flap weir is a hardware product close to the firm's core hydraulic steel engineering offer, launched only in 2024, and fits municipal flood-control demand with long sales cycles.
An energy management system for water facilities matches the firm's strategic direction toward digital networking and energy efficiency, so it is likely to be developed further rather than withdrawn.
The overflow flap gate has its own website page, sits close to the established water-level regulation business, and was only recently launched, so dropping it is unlikely.
